title: Pointwise Error Estimates for Numerical Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks are often evaluated by residual losses sampled at finitely many points, which do not by themselves certify pointwise values of a partial differential equation solution. In this work, deterministic pointwise error intervals are developed for mesh-based, piecewise-linear numerical physics-informed neural networks. The proposed error estimation is given for a compatible field, which is the finite-element reconstruction of an admissible prediction on a mesh.
